pages.text: One hot afternoon, <name> decided to surprise his grandparents with a fresh mango lassi. He carefully peeled a ripe mango and grabbed yogurt, thinking, 'This will make them so happy!'

But as he added ingredients, he got a little carried away. 'A pinch of mint for freshness… and just a tiny chili for fun,' he whispered. He didn’t realize he had added a whole chili instead of a tiny piece.

He poured the lassi into glasses and proudly presented them. 'For you, Dada and Dadi!' Grandpa took a sip first. His eyes widened, and smoke seemed to come out of his ears! 'Hhh… hmph… is it spicy?' he gasped.

Grandma laughed so hard that she almost spilled her glass. 'What is in this, <name>?!' Curious neighbors peeked over the fence. As soon as they tasted it, they coughed, giggled, and waved their hands to cool their mouths. 'It’s… interesting!' one said, laughing.
<name> ran around trying to help, giving everyone water and laughing at the funny expressions. Even the cat sniffed the glass and jumped back with a tiny squeak.

Finally, Mom stepped in and guided <name> to make a proper mango lassi without the chili. Grandpa and Grandma sipped slowly and smiled. 'Ah… that’s perfect!' <name> laughed along with everyone, realizing that mistakes can be funny. The garden was filled with giggles and the sweet, refreshing taste of the real mango lassi.
